title: rosa gallica subvar. elata
intro: Rosa gallica subvar. elata, commonly known as the French rose or Apothecary's rose, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Rosaceae family, known for its medicinal and cosmetic properties. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa gallica subvar. elata include its use as an antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent to treat wounds, skin conditions, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
